Name: Pet's Enhanced Mechanics - Dynamic Patcher By Donut
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
[left]
[size=5][color=#00ffff]Installation:[/color]
[/size][size=4]Extract the 7-zip file you download anywhere you want, as this is a Dynamic patcher it doesn't need to be/probably shouldn't be located in your Stardew valley mod folder. Open the file and use the README file AND/OR my youtube tutorial found within my mod-page and follow the instructions in order to use my patcher.[/size]

[u][size=6][color=#e06666]BIG CHANGE:[/color] [/size][size=5]Folder no longer separated based on your device, instead make sure to use batch file if on windows and .sh if on Linux/Mac, You can still follow the same process as seen in the video to use my code and now, through use of .exe files, can be used by any user![/size][/u]
[/left][center]﻿[size=5] [color=#f1c232]Youtube Tutorial on how to use my Patcher Down Below ↓[/color][/size][youtube]CFF7U1j8-qo[/youtube]
[size=5]_______________________________________________________________________________________[/size]
[size=5]Please consider Supporting the work I do through my [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/acsrpyejov]BuyMeACoffee[/url]﻿‧𓍢ִ໋☕ ׂ 𓈒 ⋆ ۪  Page![/size][/center][center]__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________[/center]
[size=5][color=#b4a7d6]Optional files[/color]:
[/size][size=4]Thought I should give a heads up before using my content patcher generator script, you may browse my Optional Files section to see if a Content Patcher Mod has already been made for the mod you're patching, which should save you some time and effort! All you have to do is generate the modified image and move that into the asset folder of the corresponding optional file!

Current Work on Optional files:
[spoiler] Elle's Cuter Dogs: No Custom Work done yet, Every dog has default hat placement of dog4 for the time being.
(Planning to getting around and doing custom hatoffsets after a bit of a break, hopefully others can provide help in this? :) )

Yet Another Dog Mod: Only Custom Work done for the MajesticPotato dog, as used in mod images, Will finish this one before Elle's More than likely

Staffy Dog: Complete, Only had One Dog to create the custom offset for, Thank the gods. 
[/spoiler]
[/size]
[size=5][color=#e69138]Disclaimer/Notes: [/color]
[/size][size=4][color=#ff0000]THIS MOD DOES NOT INCLUDE ANY ASSETS FROM ANYONE'S DOG MOD SPECIFCALLY[/color], Creation of any modified images using my Patcher is of the User's discretion, furthermore, Any assets modified by my patcher is strictly prohibited from being uploaded onto nexus, not including any content patcher code generated, these assets may not be shared on this or any other website until proper permissions are gathered from both I, and the authors of the original sprites you modify using my code.

I hope to make this mod-page a repository containing both my code/scripts (main file) needed to modify assets for Pets Enhanced Mechanics, as well as within my optional files section, content patcher codes for Specific dog mods so that any users can more easily use my patcher, simply dragging the modified dog assets into their downloaded optional file assets folder, skipping the need to run the Content Patcher Generator scripts within my mod and even hopefully, if any users want to take up the mantle and help me out, create custom hat offsets which will help with the aesthetics of your dogs! (Reach out through dm if you'd like to do this!)

To make custom offsets of certain sprites & animations within your content patcher code please refer to the excellently constructed github page by SukenLace explaining how one can do this: [/size][b][url=https://github.com/SunkenLace/Pets-Enhanced-Mod-Content-Pack-Guide?tab=readme-ov-file#editcontent--entries][size=4]https://github.com/SunkenLace/Pets-Enhanced-Mod-Content-Pack-Guide?tab=readme-ov-file#editcontent--entries[/size]

[/url][/b][size=5][color=#1e84cc]Permissions/Credit:[/color]
[/size][size=4]Huge thanks and props to the amazing author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24026?tab=description]Pets Enhanced Mechanics[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SunkenLace?gameId=1303]SukenLace[/url]﻿. They have helped me in many ways whilst attempting to develop this mod, They've both helped me understand how to create a content patch for their mod as well as given me permission to use a base asset I've created containing the surfboards and eyes used in the dog's sprite-work for their mod. This mod is merely a patcher for their mod so without them I would've never uploaded my first code project so for that, I am truly grateful.[/size]
